1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.
2. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc. must be filed on or before 05.01.2024 failing which the quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. Put up this case on 15.04.2024.
4.

In the meantime, the order dated 28.04.2023 passed by the learned SDJM, Pupri (Sitamarhi) in Mahila (Sitamarhi) P.S. Case No. 35 of 2022 whereby cognizance of offence under Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.59102 of 2023(2) dt.18-12-2023 Sections 323, 341, 498A, 504, 506 and 34 of the IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken, shall remain stayed.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are mother-in-law and father-in-law of the O.P. No. 2 and whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and wife,
